history.text: Interim tag title created after Tenzan and Chono showed signs of inactivity; Koshinaka and Makabe became the first interim champions.
Manabu Nakanishi and Takao Omori defeated Koshinaka and Makabe to become interim champions.
NJPW president Simon Kelly Inoki stripped Tenzan and Chono after they ceased teaming.
NJPW recognized Nakanishi and Omori as IWGP Tag Team Champions.
The British Invasion beat Team 3D at a TNA taping; NJPW did not sanction or recognize the title change.
NJPW recognized The British Invasion (Brutus Magnus and Doug Williams) as the current champions, making the reign official.
